format: JavaScript (Node.js module) with ES Modules syntax
description: This source file implements a Node.js-based proxy utility that intercepts and modifies JSON-formatted lines from standard input to inject server information into certain method calls, then spawns a child process to run a specified command with the modified parameters.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Decodes and validates the payload provided via command-line arguments, extracts target command and MCP server list.

methods.name: shouldInject
methods.description: Determines if a method should have MCP servers injected based on its name.

methods.name: rewriteLine
methods.description: Parses a JSON line, inserts MCP server info into specific methods, and serializes it back.

methods.name: isMainModule
methods.description: Checks whether the current script is the main module.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Coordinates the proxy operation: decodes payload, spawns child process, intercepts input/output, and manages process lifecycle.
